score_method: Rounded category means across all four actual images; all retained, none regenerated. Equal primary score is not treated as improvement.

outputs.name: Machined protective brow
outputs.limitation: The requested upper brow is weakly differentiated from a conventional rounded camera island.

outputs.name: Forged camera saddle
evidence: broad bead-blasted saddle visibly connects camera mass to frame
clear three-lens-to-flash hierarchy and mature material restraint
outputs.limitation: The top bridge is visually dominant and would need careful family scaling for lower tiers.

outputs.name: Grounded grip rail
evidence: indigo fine texture and warm background are coherent
outputs.limitation: The broadened laser-textured lower rail is barely visible, so both innovation and cultural relationship are absent at hero size.

outputs.name: Ceramic camera shoulder
evidence: ceramic-effect low-gloss red part reads as a specific rigid process zone
three cameras and flash remain ordered
outputs.limitation: The camera shoulder reads more as premium mass than a uniquely source-linked relationship, though it remains appropriately non-iconic.

schema_learning: The compact focused-process rule produces clean, mature results and avoids decorative drift. Strong functional mass carriers—frame-fed forged saddle and ceramic-effect camera shoulder—outperform subtle rail texture. The next schema should add a visibility allocation rule: if the Leading Departure is frame or edge based, composition and lighting must dedicate enough projected area to prove it.
